team.rulesIntro: Team overall uses the sum of starter OVR plus nationality bonuses that stack across different countries.
team.rulesBase: Base: sum of the 5 starters' OVR.
team.rulesCumulative: For each distinct nationality, count how many starters share that nation, apply the table to that group, then add all percentages together.
team.rulesBonusTitle: Per-group table (same nation in the lineup)
team.rulesExamples: Examples: 2 Canadians (+5%) and 2 Germans (+5%) ⇒ +10% total. 2 French (+5%) and 3 Germans (+10%) ⇒ +15%. Only one nation with 3 players ⇒ +10%.
team.rulesFormula: Overall = round(base × (1 + (sum of bonuses)/100)). Players without nationality are not in any group.
team.previewNoNationBonus: No nationality bonus (need at least 2 players from the same nation).
team.previewLargestGroup: Largest group: {{count}} player(s) from one nation.
